d:
A delicious and healthy White Sauce Pasta that you won't believe is made without any cream, butter, maida or oil! The secret ingredient is cauliflower, which gives the sauce its beautiful creamy texture, and I've also added some low-fat paneer to make it even more nutritious and flavourful.
Trust me, nobody at home will be able to guess that this white sauce is made using cauliflower! If you or your kids love white sauce pasta, this is definitely a recipe you must try.
The full written recipe is in the description below.
Happy Cooking!
